cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Obey Without Explanation
cards.instruction: Create increasingly inconvenient requests that test whether someone accepts your authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Bring that empty box to my desk. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What do you need it for?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. At present, to establish whether you'll bring it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Take it back without the question this time.

mechanism: A tests obedience with pointless box moves while conceding route and asking style to keep B willing to perform an increasingly burdensome compliance test.
confusable: Unlike useful delegation, the request purpose is acceptance of authority; borrowed authority must negotiate the test form without making it useful work.
comparison: A completed box trip turned into a longer return differs from a cold-window test extended into coat service.
seedUse: Use D59-a empty box/purpose/return and S02-b adapting requests to preserve cooperation.
